descriptor: Burnt Out Games is an independent studio making fast, loud, high-energy games.
heroSub: We make games out of whatever we can't stop thinking about. Play one and you'll feel exactly how much fun we were having.
aboutShort: We started Burnt Out Games as game design students building project after project together, because it was the best part of the week. Two games on Steam later, with EXO on the way, that hasn't changed. Every one of them started with somebody getting excited and everybody else catching it.
aboutLong:
We started Burnt Out Games as game design students, working together on project after project because it was the best part of the week. Since then we've put two games on Steam, with EXO on the way.

We play, we study, and we make. Coming at games from all three sides at once is how we keep finding new answers to what a game can even be, and pushing on that is the entire reason we're here.

Everything we've built started with one person getting excited and everyone else catching it off them. That's the fire. It's a lot more fun shared.

GLFH.
communityHeading: Come bog it up with us
communityBlurb: Updates, playtests, and bogging it up. We're busy breaking speed itself in EXO, and the server is where you'll see it first and get your hands on it first. Bring your fire, we'll bring ours.
teamBlurb: Ten of us, plus the contributors who jumped on EXO. We're all game design students, and we all play the things we make.
gamesIntro: A speed shooter, a horror story, and a maze that gives four people one torch. We build whichever idea we're most excited about, which is why no two of them look alike.
devlogIntro: The parts we get excited about and can't fit into thirty seconds. Systems we're proud of, things we worked out along the way, and the occasional accident that turned into a feature.
contactBlurb: One inbox, and we read all of it. Press, publishing, playtesting, or just to tell us what you thought.
